summary: Increment 1 of the world-engine history program: a deterministic, three-free despun/ice-shell relief writer (src/worldengine/base/shellRelief.js), sibling of plates.js, that replaces the sin^2(lat) fallback for icy-active / volatile-cold / eyeball-despun bodies ONLY, organized about a seeded paleo-spin axis w0 and tidal axis t_hat, and never touches the validated Earth-like plate path.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: DETERMINISM + NO-RNG: shellRelief.js contains no Math.random()/Date.now() call form, and writeShellReliefSphere run twice on the same fresh 600-node carrier yields byte-identical fields, for every seed x regime; |U| < SHELL_BOUND.

verifyVia.input: Static-grep shellRelief.js for /Math\.random\s*\(|Date\.now\s*\(/ (zero matches) + render-once guard (one while-drain, no convergence-while); run writeShellReliefSphere(carrier,{},{macroSeed:s,regime:r}) twice for s in {1,2,3,7,42} x r in {icy-active,volatile-cold,eyeball-despun}.
verifyVia.observable: Zero RNG matches; byte-identical U, grainAngle, faultDensity, cellId, stressTensile (Float32Array equality) across the two runs for every (s,r); |U[i]| < SHELL_BOUND for all nodes.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: STRUCTURE BAR (signal must PASS): the field is explained by stress geometry, with a predictor rebuilt ARM'S-LENGTH from published thetaTraj/stressTensile geometry (NOT from lineamentNode, to avoid circularity).

verifyVia.input: On the 600-node carrier, per regime, rebuild a signed lineament-stress-proximity predictor via BFS geodesic falloff from the published stress geometry; measure corr(U, predictor); compare lineament-node amplitude to the per-regime quiet denominator (cells for icy-active/volatile-cold; quiet/non-lineament plains for eyeball-despun); measure corr(thetaTraj, despin principal-axis about w0).
verifyVia.observable: |corr(U, signed stress-proximity)| >= 0.5; lineament(ridge-shoulder) amplitude >= 2x the per-regime quiet denominator; corr(thetaTraj, despin principal-axis about w0) >= 0.5 for eyeball-despun + volatile-cold. [Exact threshold values + the stress closed-forms pending research workflow wccpy01ez — MUST-FIX #1.]

acceptanceCriteria.statement: LATITUDE CONTROL (must FAIL): U is NOT explained by carrier +y latitude bands — the load-bearing falsifier vs the sin^2(lat) fallback this writer replaces.

verifyVia.input: Correlate U vs sin^2(carrier +y latitude), all three regimes.
verifyVia.observable: varExplainedByLatitudeY < 0.15 AND strictly < varExplainedByStress, for every regime.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: TILTED-BAND CONTROL (must hold): the DISCRETE lineament network — not the underlying despin band tilted onto a random pole — carries the structure. Guards the 'rotated sin^2' fake; depends on the double-ridge cross-section being active in eyeball-despun.

verifyVia.input: Correlate U vs sin^2(colatitude about the seeded w0); confirm the analytic double-ridge cross-section (trough + two shoulders) is applied in eyeball-despun so U oscillates ACROSS each ring.
verifyVia.observable: varExplainedByStress > varExplainedByLatitudeW0 for all regimes, including eyeball-despun.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: NOISE CONTROL (must FAIL): the real stress-gated field beats pure noise, and a control variant with BOTH the sigma1 gate AND the thetaTraj steering disabled collapses the structure signal.

verifyVia.input: Correlate U vs an amplitude-matched independent simplex field; build a noise-control variant of the writer with the sigma1 gate disabled AND thetaTraj steering replaced by isotropic/random steering.
verifyVia.observable: corr(U, matched-noise) < 0.15; the gates+steering-disabled variant FAILS AC2(a) (corr collapses toward 0) AND AC2(b) (the 2x ratio breaks); the real field PASSES.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: VARIETY: two different macroSeeds produce different worlds, each reproducible per seed.

verifyVia.input: Build the field with two different macroSeeds, same regime.
verifyVia.observable: Different cellCount AND < 0.2 node-overlap of lineamentNode AND different w0; each seed reproducible.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: NO-CLOBBER of the Earth-like plate path: terrestrial/ocean unlocked bodies still route to the plate writer, byte-identical to a pre-change baseline.

verifyVia.input: Call writeBodyRelief with archetype in {terrestrial, ocean}, locked=false.
verifyVia.observable: Returns path:'plate' with shellDiag:null; the plate U field is byte-identical to the captured pre-change baseline; the plate AC2 structure test still passes unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: NO-CLOBBER of the despun/zonal fallback + dispatch safety: non-shell non-earthlike bodies keep the byte-identical despun path, and a locked gas/lava world must NOT match the shell writer (SHELL_EXCLUDE).

verifyVia.input: Call writeBodyRelief with impact-airless (unlocked) and gas-giant; and with a locked gas body (null+locked, and explicit gas-giant+locked) and a locked lava body.
verifyVia.observable: shellRegimeOf returns null; path:'despun', byte-identical to baseline; the locked gas/lava bodies do NOT match shellRegimeOf because gas-giant/sub-neptune/lava/carbon/crystal/terrestrial/ocean are in SHELL_EXCLUDE.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: SEAM FIRES: with the PRESET_ARCHETYPE additions the lab presets route to the right regimes; and the null+locked Europa fall-through still routes (never silently to sin^2).

verifyVia.input: With the 'Europa (icy moon)':'ice' and 'Titan (methane seas)':'volatile' PRESET_ARCHETYPE additions, route Europa/Frozen/Eyeball/Titan; then with the additions REMOVED, route the null+locked Europa.
verifyVia.observable: Europa->icy-active, Frozen->icy-active, Eyeball->eyeball-despun, Titan->volatile-cold; with additions removed, null+locked Europa still ->eyeball-despun via the locked-fallback. (NOTE: Titan is single-covered by its map line only — locked:false, no fallback net — so dropping the Titan line silently regresses it to bands.)

acceptanceCriteria.statement: LIVE shellProbe: in the running lab, the four target presets bake onto the carrier and the probe proves the field is real stress geometry, not latitude — and the landforms look distinct.

verifyVia.input: In the lab on :9223, select Europa (then Frozen, Eyeball, Titan), window._lab.setSeed(1234); window._lab.reliefBakeStrength(1); force a route; window._lab.shellProbe(); take a screenshot.
verifyVia.observable: heightSource=='carrier'; regime matches the preset; varExplainedByStress > varExplainedByLatitudeY AND > varExplainedByLatitudeW0; lineamentInteriorRatio >= 2; grainStressCorr high for eyeball/volatile; screenshot shows distinct cracks/cycloids/chaos vs sin^2 bands.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: UAT (Max-only): each of Europa/Frozen/Eyeball/Titan reads as a distinct, recognizable icy/despun world-type and coheres as the experience Max wanted — not a latitude smear.

verifyVia.input: Max views Europa/Frozen/Eyeball/Titan in the lab (against a recording per the Max recording protocol if motion matters).
verifyVia.observable: Max judges each as a genuinely distinct icy/despun world; holistic acceptance. Never PASSed by any agent — deferred-to-max.
